neighbours.label: The preposition that introduces what an evaluated means is for: 'a great way to', 'the cheapest way of', 'an ideal base for', vs bare purpose 'to' and 'no way'
fire: Taking the night train is a relaxing way to see the countryside.
Walking tours are the best way of learning about the city's history.
The cabin makes an ideal base for hiking in the national park.
A boat trip is a lovely way to spend an afternoon on the lake.
Buses are a cheap way of getting between the villages.
The hostel is a perfect starting point for exploring the old quarter.
Cooking classes are a fun way to meet people when you move abroad.
Cycling is an easy way of getting around the flat island.
quiet: Taking the night train, we wanted to see the countryside.
Walking tours of the city's history start every morning.
The cabin is small, and there is no way four people fit inside.
A boat trip on the lake was cancelled because of the wind.
Buses between the villages are slow and often late.
The hostel is cheap, but you need to book early.
Cooking classes meet people's needs when they move abroad.
Cycling around the flat island takes about three hours.

predictions: 'a great/cheap/ideal way/idea/base to/of/for' + activity 0.35-0.8; infinitive 'to' after want/need, 'no way he' under 0.05.
short: purpose slot after an evaluated means
notes: Card: ' to' x10, ' of' x4 in 'an excellent way of getting around', 'the ultimate way to experience', 'ideal starting point для'.
